preserved_prototype.explanation: Initial larger-tile prototype passed conformance but was superseded before candidate native timing to enforce the resource model's existing 64 MiB quotient workspace allowance.

baseline_run_01.explanation: Executed by prove-01.py while prototype source was present. Executed baseline source and binaries are pinned and identical to the other four baseline trials; candidate source was not executed.

preserved_failures.reason: The controller omitted LATTICA_V2_GPU_RETAIN_TREES=1; device commitments rejected missing retained trees.
preserved_failures.correction: native-02.py adds the required setting. No production source correction was needed for this failure.

limitations: Five matched AB/BA native proof-job pairs compare two GPU-required implementations on one desktop RTX 5080. They do not measure delivered transaction throughput or compare against hybrid proving.
Cold and warm refer to preprocessing cache state inside each new worker process. Stage inclusive spans overlap and must not be summed as wall time.

Conformance qualifies quadratic and cubic quotient arithmetic; repeated full-size latency trials use research JoinSplit/JoinSplit pairs. Candidate HTLC/HTLC, merge and real pool finalizer routes are additional correctness checks.
Roots reuse archived wallet inputs and candidate pair/merge proofs. This does not count freshly delivered transactions or continuously live mixed-key cache throughput.

Observed caps, selected private-data/spill/staging/stack partitions and cleanup do not establish complete mapping, driver, kernel or scheduler phase-lifetime admission. Ordinary incomplete profiles remain inadmissible.
Build memory.events max counts are retained. Successful completion without OOM or swap does not imply absence of memory pressure.

Remaining gates include maintained routes, five matched delivered-throughput versus hybrid pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64 cold <=600 s, post-seal application <=180 s, depth 6 and roots <=2 MiB.
Multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and the pending local Mac source checkpoint remain open; the overall GPU proving goal is incomplete.
